findings.summary: validateSliceCorrection fail-open on omitted regression or detected:true without attributable impacted_slices
findings.evidence: L648 defaults missing regression to detected:false; detected:true with empty impacted_slices does not throw; failed ignores regression.detected unlike v1; can set passed then approved
findings.why_it_matters: Breaks fail-closed cross-slice regression and can approve without attributable impact evidence
findings.acceptance_criteria: Require regression with detected and non-empty evidence; detected:true without attributable impacted_slices must throw; no passed/approved with unattributed regression

findings.evidence: Requires correction-required with no idempotent branch; v1 beginCorrection returns clone(state) on exact retry
findings.why_it_matters: After interrupted persisted start, exact retry fails instead of safe ack
findings.acceptance_criteria: Same request_id and exact pending state while correcting returns clone(state); divergence throws

findings.evidence: resolutions only seeded at attachRemediationV2; validateSliceCorrection updates findings/status/regression_history but never slice.resolutions
findings.acceptance_criteria: Sync slice.resolutions with findings; integrity fails on divergence

findings.summary: Go persistResultEnvelope missing orphan .bak recovery vs JS
findings.evidence: JS recoverOrphanBak before re-read; Go ReadFile error returns nil with no bak recovery
findings.why_it_matters: Partial rename can leave state.yaml unreadable; Go silently no-ops
findings.acceptance_criteria: Parity with JS orphan bak recovery under lock before read
